name: @digitalarsenal/terrain-source-watch
description: The monthly source check of the terrain refresh flow: probes the walk's source files, diffs them against the raw/<naif>/ mirror.

scripts.e2e: npm --prefix ../../storage run provision && npm ci --ignore-scripts && node tools/generate-sources.mjs --check && node --test tests/terrain-source-watch.e2e.mjs
